caveats: Every index here is a weighted formula over observed counts and distances — a DATA-DRIVEN SCORE, not a machine-learning model. No labelled 'well-served ward' outcome exists to train or validate one.
Facility counts come from OpenStreetMap. Completeness varies, so a low score may indicate under-mapping rather than under-provision.
Distances are straight-line from the ward centroid, not road distance.
Market figures cover only wards the property dataset could be matched to; unmatched wards report null, never zero.
This is a research prototype and is not an official planning instrument.
